scientific_integrity: A uniform symbolic proof establishes all prime powers; seven exact finite-field spectra were checked separately and are not used as an infinite-field argument. External independent review has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Odd finite fields with q congruent to one modulo four; exponent d=(q-1)/4 at least two; results concern the explicit 3d^2 coordinate-pairing lines, without asserting they exhaust all possible lines. Earlier classical line geometry and isolated low-degree rational-point specializations are acknowledged. An old equivalent fourth-root incidence count may exist; independent priority adjudication has not been performed.
title: Fourth-root Fermat surfaces: line coverage and exceptional characteristics
